user.title: My rules
user.hint: Apply to every book. The first match from the top wins; if nothing matches, the approval mode decides.

empty.title: No rules yet
empty.description: Without rules the approval mode decides everything. You could deny git push, ask before writing chapters, or deny prompts with certain words.

project.title: Rules for {{title}}
project.hint: In .nbook/permissions.json in the book's folder; apply to this book only. They can only ask or deny.
project.invalid: This file can't be read or isn't valid, so writes and commands in this book will ask.
project.empty: This book has no rules of its own.
project.allowIgnored: Allow has no effect here: a book someone gave you can't allow things on your behalf.
project.unavailable: This book's rules could not be loaded. They still apply when calls are judged.

field.reason: Reason (optional; tells the model what to do instead)

modeWrite.label: Writes in Discuss and Plan modes
modeWrite.hint: When denied, the model is told and can ask to switch modes. When asked, an approval prompt appears.

readOnly.label: Additional read-only commands
readOnly.hint: One per line, matched by word prefix. You can add to the built-in list but not remove from it.

toolBindings.title: Agent tool bindings
toolBindings.description: Add or remove tools per profile: added brings in tools the profile does not list, removed drops optional ones (required tools stay)

profileSettings.title: Profile settings
profileSettings.description: The model or model role per profile, and the approval mode new sessions start with

modelRetries.title: Model request retries
modelRetries.description: How many times a failed model request is sent again; 0 turns retries off

warnCost.title: Cost warning (USD)
warnCost.description: Warns once when this session's cost reaches this amount; 0 turns it off. Models without a price are not counted

maxCost.title: Cost limit (USD)
maxCost.description: Stops sending model requests when this session's cost reaches this amount; the last request may go slightly over. 0 means no limit. Models without a price are not counted, so the limit does not apply to them

permissionRules.title: Permission rules
permissionRules.description: Rules that allow, ask for or deny tool calls. Each names a tool, a condition and an action; the first match from the top wins

readOnlyCommands.title: Extra read-only commands
readOnlyCommands.description: Compared word by word as prefixes, such as npm ls. You can add to the built-in list but not remove from it

modeWriteAction.title: Writes in discuss and plan modes
modeWriteAction.description: Deny and tell the model to switch modes, or ask for approval

toolLoopThreshold.title: Repeated call threshold
toolLoopThreshold.description: Reminds the model after this many identical tool calls in a row, and stops the run if the results stay the same after the reminder; 0 turns it off

reliability.title: Run reliability
reliability.description: Retries for failed model requests, stall timeouts, the context compaction trigger, and guards for cost and repeated calls

reject.readOnly: This session is read-only right now.
reject.ruleNotSaved: Approved, but the rule was not saved, so you will be asked again ({{code}}).

model.unknown: The model this session uses doesn't exist or can't be used.
model.roleUnbound: The model role this Profile wants has no model.

ask.label: Always ask
ask.description: Everything except reads waits for your approval (default)

allowWrites.label: Allow writes
allowWrites.description: Edits go ahead, commands still ask

yolo.label: Allow everything
yolo.description: Never asks; only deny rules can stop a call

auto.label: Auto
auto.description: Commands go to an approval model first, and to you if it is unsure. The model can miss things, so this is not a security boundary

reason.mode: This session is in Discuss or Plan mode, and this call counts as a write.
reason.autoFailed: The approval model gave no verdict this time. Please decide.
reason.autoEscalated: The approval model passed this to you: {{reason}}

fork.unknown: Not sure whether the fork was created. Run /fork again; it will not create a second one.

renameCommand.needTitle: Add the new title, for example /rename Ending of chapter three.

mentions.title: Project files
mentions.noProject: Open a work to reference its files
mentions.failed: Could not search files. Try again

attachment.tooLarge: A file can be at most 25 MB.
attachment.noSession: Could not create a session for this attachment.

history.unknown: Not sure whether that worked. Try again; it will not run twice.
history.failed: That did not work ({{code}}). The conversation is unchanged.

context.unavailable: The next request cannot be worked out: this session has no usable model or profile.

compact.noModel: No model is set for compaction. Bind one to the Compaction role in settings.
compact.noSession: There is no conversation yet, so there is nothing to compact.
compact.queued: Will compact when this step finishes.
compact.unknown: The result of the compact command is unknown. Check whether a compaction divider appeared; if not, send it again.

active.reason: No session is running or waiting for you

permissions.title: Permission rules
permissions.description: Which tool calls are allowed, asked about, or denied

profiles.title: Profiles
profiles.description: The model, starting approval mode, and tools of each profile

problem.toolsMissingDetail: Missing required tools {{tools}}. Install the plugin that provides them to restore it.
problem.keyTaken: Unavailable: a plugin already uses this name
problem.keyTakenDetail: A plugin already uses {{key}}. Rename the file to restore it.
problem.moduleNotSharedComputed: Module names can't be computed at run time
problem.moduleDetail: Only modules NeuroBook provides and files by relative path can be imported.
problem.invalidExport: The default export isn't the result of defineProfile
problem.invalidIdDetail: The file name decides the id, which must be {{id}}.
problem.stale: The last version that worked is still in use.
problem.never: This profile has never loaded, so it can't be used.

model.label: Model
model.modelGone: This model can't be used right now
model.roleBroken: The model bound to the "{{role}}" role can't be used right now

approval.label: Approval mode
approval.hint: Only sets the starting value for new sessions; you can switch inside a session
approval.auto: A model decides first and asks you when unsure; it can miss things
approval.yolo: Nothing needs approval; only deny rules can block a call

section.help: Changes apply from the next model request, including sessions already open.

tools.goneSummary: This tool wasn't found. Install the plugin that provides it to restore it.

add.title: Add tools
add.empty: There are no tools to add
add.replaces: Replaces the enabled tool with the same name.
add.blocked: Conflicts with a required tool of the same name, so it can't be added.

summary.read: Reads files and folders, and can view images.
summary.write: Writes a whole file: creates it if missing, overwrites it if not.
summary.edit: Edits a file by line anchors, several places at once.
summary.edit-replace: Replaces a piece of text in a file.
summary.grep: Searches file contents with a regular expression.
summary.switch-mode: Asks to switch to discuss, plan, or normal mode.
summary.ask: Asks the user with fixed choices.
summary.ask-form: Asks the user, with choices or a form.

create.title: New profile
create.name: Name
create.hint: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens only. The file is user://profiles/{{name}}.profile.tsx and the key is user.{{name}}.
create.hintEmpty: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens only.
create.invalid: Use lowercase letters, digits and hyphens only, and don't start or end with a hyphen.
create.exists: A profile with this name already exists.

skeleton.system: You are a writing assistant. Follow the author's requests, and ask when unsure.

remove.title: Delete "{{name}}"?
remove.description: The file is deleted permanently, and sessions using it become read-only. Other files it imports stay.

needs.context: This model's context window is {{have}}; this profile needs {{need}}
